summary: @or-sdk/account-settings preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled, heavily obfuscated bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, shuffled string-array cipher, `_0x...` identifiers, sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) with no source form in the tarball and no relation to the package's advertised purpose (an account-settings SDK). Execution fires automatically on `npm install`, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's host under the identity of the user running install. The alternate-runtime step (fetching Bun so that a Bun-compiled binary can run) is the standard shape of a scanner-evasion dropper: it moves the payload out of Node's reach so its behavior cannot be inspected by Node-focused tooling, and the payload itself is opaque and unrelated to the SDK's declared API surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
